explanation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D | CC BY 4.0; filtered and aggregated derivative.
Inventory availability and lost demand are absent; zero sales may reflect missing availability.
Reference price observed in initial training. Costs 45/55/65%, salvage 10%, penalty 10% are assumptions.
52 initial training, 13 diagnostics, 39 rolling test weeks. Each decision sees preceding 52 weeks only.
Paired independent-replicate numerical interval; excludes history, model and economic uncertainty.
Hypothetical disruption 0/10/25%; delivered fraction 65%, latent correlation 0. No observed supplier data.
Slicers select precomputed seeded runs. New assumptions require Python export then Power BI Refresh.
Modeled profit/service proxies. No actual company savings, causal uplift or live procurement.
